replication.claim: Most neuron activations can be zeroed per token with little damage
replication.published: keep 320/4,096 (92.2% ablated): loss 1.886 → 1.940 (+2.9%), KL 0.140 (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B MoE); open Qwen3-1.7B replication: KL ≈ 0.80
replication.criterion: relative loss increase < 25% and KL < 1.0, and the random-480 control at least 3× worse in loss increase

replication.claim: The few large activations carry the computation
replication.published: ablating only the top 12.5% per expert → loss 4.587 (bottom-448 control)
replication.ours: zeroing only the top 480 per token → loss 14.329 (base 3.030)
replication.criterion: loss increase ≥ 5× that of keeping only the top 480

replication.claim: Gate-open quadrants carry causal weight although most activations are gate-closed
replication.published: top attributed cells: Q1 39–50% + Q2 43–57%; 71–72% of all activations in Q3/Q4
replication.ours: top-1% gradient×activation cells: 56% gate-open (Q1+Q2); all activations: 80% gate-closed
replication.criterion: ≥ 80% of top cells gate-open and ≥ 50% of all activations gate-closed
